exposure: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) requiring cesarean hysterectomy
Women with PAS requiring hysterectomy vs. women with risk factors for PAS who underwent Cesarean delivery without hysterectomy (3 or more prior Cesareans or placenta previa)
cohort: Women with risk factors for PAS who were enrolled antenatally.
finding: Women with PAS are more likely to report ongoing long-term health issues and decreased quality of life for up to 3 years following surgery than those undergoing Cesarean for other indications.
